children: Forgent Power Solutions, Inc. reported sharply higher full-year 2026 revenue and improved earnings, driven by strong demand from data center and grid customers and growth in engineered-to-order product lines.
Revenue was $1.42B, compared with $753.2M in the prior year; YoY change 89%.
Net income was $81.8M, compared with $15.2M in the prior year; YoY change 439%.
Diluted EPS was $0.3, compared with — in the prior year.
Revenue growth: Revenues surged 89% to $1.42B year-over-year, supported by robust demand from data center and grid customers.
Backlog & demand: Backlog reached $3.0B, up 256%, signaling sustained near-term demand and production pull-through.
Product mix shift: Growth was led by Custom Products and Powertrain Solutions (engineered-to-order) versus Standard Products.
Capacity expansion: New manufacturing campuses began production; ramp-related startup and under-absorption costs weighed on margins.
Market positioning: The company is positioned as a vertically integrated, reliability-focused supplier to data centers, utilities, independent power producers and industrial customers.
